title: Mass Assignment - Barber Active Status Manipulation via PATCH /api/v1/barbers/:id
description: The PATCH /api/v1/barbers/:id endpoint in the vulnerable API accepts an 'active' field in the request body through the updateBarberSchema Zod schema. The schema includes 'active: z.boolean().optional()'. The handler passes the entire parsed data (including active) to the UpdateBarber use case. This allows any authenticated user with access to this endpoint (currently any authenticated user due to missing RBAC) to deactivate or activate any barber by ID.
impact: Barber availability manipulation. Any authenticated user can deactivate or activate any barber, disrupting scheduling and availability. Combined with IDOR (no ownership check on PATCH /barbers/:id), any user can manipulate any barber's active status.
mitigation: 1) Remove 'active' field from updateBarberSchema in vulnerable API (secure API already excludes it). 2) The UpdateBarber use case should not accept active status changes from client input. 3) Barber activation/deactivation should be a separate administrative action with proper authorization.

history.details: Initial audit finding recorded for mass assignment of active in barber update
